contracts.title: # BUILD PHASE 00: Capture the current Premake reference
# BUILD PHASE 01: Resolve dependency provenance and pin decisions
# BUILD PHASE 02: Freeze source ownership and comparison tooling
# BUILD PHASE 03: Introduce the CMake foundation and MSVC policies
# BUILD PHASE 04: Add Conan profiles and foundation packages
# BUILD PHASE 05: Isolate the vendored implementation targets
# BUILD PHASE 06: Integrate SDL2 and text-rendering packages
# BUILD PHASE 07: Integrate Assimp and oneTBB packages
# BUILD PHASE 08: Model the local FMOD SDK with imported targets
# BUILD PHASE 09: Extract the Core foundation target
# BUILD PHASE 10: Extract Math and neutral bounds
# BUILD PHASE 11: Extract Events and shared input value declarations
# BUILD PHASE 12: Remove Physics header and PCH dependence on scene components
# BUILD PHASE 13: Extract the Physics kernel target
# BUILD PHASE 14: Prepare the Graphics and Assets ownership boundary
# BUILD PHASE 15: Extract the Graphics target
# BUILD PHASE 16: Extract procedural Geometry
# BUILD PHASE 17: Extract image and model Assets
# BUILD PHASE 18: Extract Animation and its import boundary
# BUILD PHASE 19: Prepare the one-way Scene to Physics integration
# BUILD PHASE 20: Separate ECS components from Render statistics and helpers
# BUILD PHASE 21: Extract the ECS Scene target
# BUILD PHASE 22: Remove Input and event dispatch dependence on BaseApp
# BUILD PHASE 23: Invert the Platform and UI lifecycle boundary
# BUILD PHASE 24: Extract Platform window and context services
# BUILD PHASE 25: Extract Input services
# BUILD PHASE 26: Extract Audio with FMOD ownership
# BUILD PHASE 27: Extract UI and its backend integration
# BUILD PHASE 28: Remove Render dependence on Application services
# BUILD PHASE 29: Extract the Render target
# BUILD PHASE 30: Extract Application composition
# BUILD PHASE 31: Migrate the PhysicsBenchmark target closure
# BUILD PHASE 32: Migrate PhysicsTests while preserving scene coverage
# BUILD PHASE 33: Add verified runtime DLL staging
# BUILD PHASE 34: Stage resources and declare application working directories
# BUILD PHASE 35: Migrate GEngineEditor
# BUILD PHASE 36: Migrate RigidBodySimulation
# BUILD PHASE 37: Migrate Breakout
# BUILD PHASE 38: Migrate RayTracing
# BUILD PHASE 39: Add Python setup and build orchestration
# BUILD PHASE 40: Complete Python run, build-run, test and safe clean
# BUILD PHASE 41: Demonstrate full Premake and CMake equivalence
# BUILD PHASE 42: Make CMake and Conan the authoritative build
# BUILD PHASE 43: Retire Premake after the authoritative switch
